nodes.scope: Illumina explanatory schematic: leftmost grouped caption and yellow-highlighted accessible chromatin icon; Open DNA -> Crosslink protein and DNA with formalin -> Sonicate -> Phenol extract and purify DNA from the aqueous phase -> DNA.
